notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New: Updated boss battle; updated behaviors, added new audio, smoothed motion, and more
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 0.6 - Controller Support
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New: Controllers are now fully supported
[*] New: Added key to buy/sell multiple items at a time
[*] Changes: Cosmetic changes to character customization
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 0.5.1 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix: 'F' key or controller 'X'/Square now correctly repairs and deposits all minerals.
[*] Fix: Reduced late-game mineral hardness to match expected upgrade levels
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update 0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New: Added overheat visual indicator on player character
[*] New: Hull upgrades now show required mineral
[*] Change: Merchants now only purchase your most valuable 6 minerals
[*] Change: Change sell items sorting to Highest first
[*] Fix: Improved controller support. Does not work at Mineral Processor
[*] Fix: Depth meter is now more accurate
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update 0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: Now preventing the same merchant from appearing more than twice in a row
[*] Change: Raised the height where the underground goes dark. Decreased the price of lights to make this easier.
[*] Change: Low Oxygen warnings don't start as early with later oxygen upgrades
[*] Change: Showing item level (if any) in shop menu
[*] Change: Paint customization unlocks at Hull upgrade level 2
[*] Change: Merchant now always leaves shortly after selling out his inventory
[*] Fix: Builder merchant will have more than just pipes at reputation levels > 0
[*] Fix: Reputation is now being saved when loading or between lives
[*] Fix: Placed platforms are now loading from saved games
[*] Fix: No longer allowing purchase of new equipment when all slots are full
[*] Fix: Lowest Depth on save game is now accurate. It was previously wrong about about 20%
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update 0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New: Added customization tab at repair station
[*] Fix: Deactivating pipes correctly after breaking pipelines
[*] Fix: Crash bug when exiting to menu then clicking 'Play'
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Hotfix 0.2.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed merchants not appearing after loading a saved game
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update 0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New: Added item level to tool icons
[*] New: Dug tiles can refill when time passes
[*] New: End screen after dying past year 2700
[*] Change: Changed input keys
[*] Change: Changed fonts
[*] Change: Tuned difficulty settings. They affect the experience more now.
[/list]

notes.title: Initial Playtest Patch
notes.content: Fixes breaking bugs before launching public play test.
